question: What three major fields come together to make up nursing informatics?
explanation: You've got this! Nursing informatics simply blends nursing practice with computer and information sciences to help us handle healthcare data smoothly. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: What is the main goal of nursing informatics when handling information?
explanation: Think of it as a ladder: we take raw data, turn it into useful information, apply it as clinical knowledge, and use it with professional wisdom! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h1)

question: Which of these is a great example of clinical nursing informatics right at the bedside?

options.D: Staff payroll and duty roster software

explanation: Spot on! Scanning patient barcodes right at the bedside helps keep medication administration safe and accurate. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: Why do nurses check electronic health records for recent lab results before giving a medication?

options.A: Reduce hospital utility and electricity expenses
options.B: Eliminate the need for physical patient assessments
options.C: Minimize human errors and adverse drug reactions
options.D: Decrease the total number of hospitalized patients

explanation: Checking real-time data is a fantastic safety habit that catches mistakes before they can harm our patients. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h2)

question: What do nurse managers mostly use administrative informatics software for?

options.A: Administer intravenous fluids to surgical cases
options.C: Diagnose rare tropical diseases in patients
options.D: Track staffing levels and unit performance metrics

explanation: Administrative software helps managers keep things running smoothly by sorting out staff schedules and tracking unit activities. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Why would nurse leaders look at past hospital admission trends using a database?

options.A: To diagnose underlying causes of patient infections
options.B: To determine individual nurse salary deductions
options.C: To select medical equipment for procurement tenders
options.D: To create adequate and fair duty rosters

explanation: By checking past busy periods, managers can plan ahead and make sure there are enough nurses on duty for the next shift. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h3)

question: Which tool is commonly used when teaching and learning nursing?

options.A: Electronic billing and health insurance portals
options.D: Learning management systems and simulation software

explanation: Just like the portal you might use for your nursing courses, learning systems and simulators are everyday tools in nursing education! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: What is the biggest benefit of clinical simulation software for nursing students?

options.A: It eliminates the need for classroom lectures
options.B: It allows practice without risking patient safety
options.D: It automatically completes all hospital documentation

explanation: Simulators give you a safe space to practice procedures and make mistakes without putting any real patients at risk. Brilliant for building confidence! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h4)

question: Which software package is commonly used by researchers to analyze healthcare data?
explanation: SPSS and NVivo are the go-to tools researchers use to make sense of numbers and interview findings in health studies. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: What is the main goal of nursing research informatics?

options.A: To calculate monthly nurse salaries and bonuses
options.B: To manage hospital cafeteria meal supplies
options.C: To support evidence-based practice through digital tools
options.D: To monitor patient vital signs at the bedside

explanation: Research informatics helps gather and study evidence so we can improve how we care for patients every day. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h5)

question: Who is consumer health informatics mainly built to help?
explanation: It's all about the patients! This branch of informatics helps everyday people track and understand their own health using technology. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: If a patient uses a smartphone app to log their blood pressure at home, what is this called?
explanation: Yes! Any health tool meant directly for patients to use in managing their own care falls under consumer health informatics. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h6)

question: Which of these is NOT a major challenge facing nursing informatics in Nigeria?

options.B: High cost of digital health software

explanation: We know power supply can be unstable in many clinics, so 'abundant and reliable power' is definitely not one of our current challenges! [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)

question: What positive development is helping Nigerian healthcare beat some of its infrastructure challenges?

options.A: The rise of mobile health and telehealth solutions
options.B: The total replacement of nurses with robots
options.C: The complete abandonment of all paper records
options.D: The removal of computers from all hospital wards

explanation: Mobile health is a game-changer! It lets us bring tech and care to patients flexibly, even when infrastructure is tricky. [learn more](GNS113_U1_T2#GNS113_U1_T2_h7)
